crossRefs.note: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

people.name: Ahijah
people.line: Son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah

people.name: Bunah
people.line: Son of Jerahmeel, descendant of Judah

people.name: Hezron
people.line: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.

people.name: Jerahmeel
people.line: Son of Hezron, a descendant of Judah.

people.name: Ram
people.line: Firstborn son of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah

translations.web: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translations.bsb: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
translations.asv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the first-born of Hezron were Ram the first-born, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
